items.title: Learn Why The Bull Case For Cigna Group (CI) Could Change Following Higher EPS Outlook
items.summary: Cigna Group reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$73,683 million and net income of US$1,442 million, and projected 10% to 14% annual adjusted EPS growth through 2030 supported by a US$3 billion modernization and productivity program. The Specialty and Care Services unit generated stronger pre tax adjusted income through wider use of lower cost biosimilars and specialty generics, which now sits alongside long term earnings guidance as a key pillar of Cigna Group’s business story.
